name: Curtis Jones

career_stints.note: Liverpool academy graduate (debut April 2019); no other senior club, so this is his entire senior career, all-competitions totals to date. Assists total not reliably verifiable across sources, omitted rather than guessed. Squad-listed as DM/RB/AM/CM but no reliable per-position minutes breakdown was found -- 2025/26 reporting (Premier League site, footballinsider247) consistently describes him as Liverpool's most progressive central midfielder this season, occasionally covering right-back in squad emergencies, so a single CM entry is used here.

notes: 2025/26 Premier League season: 34 appearances, 1930 minutes, 1 goal, 2 assists. All-competitions 2025/26: 48 appearances (20 off the bench), 3 goals, 2 assists.

shots_per90 (1.03) and xg_per90 (0.11, non-penalty) are 2025/26 Premier League figures sourced via a footystats.org search snippet (22 shots in 34 matches); the underlying FootyStats page itself returns HTTP 403 to direct fetch, consistent with known access issues for that site in this project.

pass_accuracy_pct, progressive_passes_per90, touches_per90, duels_won_pct could not be pinned to a specific, reliable per-90 number. TheAnalyst.com coverage mentions he 'leads his EPL peers with an average of nine passes into the final third per 90' and cites '>90% passing accuracy since 2019-20' and '68% duel success' from a 231-minute sample -- these are directionally informative but not clean, single-season, schema-matching per-90 figures, so left null rather than force-fit.
Sources: premierleague.com, statmuse.com, lfchistory.net, footystats.org (via search), footballinsider247.com, theanalyst.com -- via web search 2026-08-10.
